name: Jahoda

"Windthreading Shadow" Jahoda

Persistent thought brings light to even the deepest secrets.

desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Skill</color>
Deals 2 <color=#80ffd7>Anemo DMG</color> , creates 1 stack of <color=#ffffff>Agile Switch</color> , and switch to your next character. If you do not have <color=#ffffff>Purr-loined Treasure Flask</color> of any element in your Hand, create 1 <color=#ffffff>Purr-loined Treasure Flask</color> in your Hand. Otherwise, grant <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> to all <color=#ffffff>Purr-loined Treasure Flask</color> in your Hand.
<color=#ebe4d8>Agile Switch</color>
<color=#ffd680>Combat Status</color>
<color=#ffffff>The next time you perform "Switch Character":</color> This switch will be considered a <color=#ffffff>Fast Action</color> instead of a <color=#ffffff>Combat Action</color> . (Can stack, no stack limit)

desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
Deals 3 <color=#80ffd7>Anemo DMG</color> and creates <color=#ffffff>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color> .
<color=#ebe4d8>Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots</color>
<color=#ffd680>Combat Action</color>
<color=#ffffff>End Phase:</color> Deals 1 Anemo DMG if your active character is Dendro or Geo; otherwise, deals 1 DMG of that character's Elemental Type. Heal the character on your team that has taken the most damage for 2 HP.
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s)</color> : 2

<color=#ffd680>Passive Skill</color>
(Passive) When battle begins, create 1 <color=#ffffff>Purr-loined Treasure Flask</color> in your Hand.
After you trigger a Lunar Reaction or Swirl Reaction, attach <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> to all <color=#ffffff>Purr-loined Treasure Flask</color> in your Hand. (Twice per Round)

<color=#ffd680>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffff>When Jahoda switches to become the active character:</color> If the opponent's active character is affected by Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo, convert this card to the corresponding element.
<color=#ffffff>Combat Action</color> : Deal 2 <color=#80ffd7>Anemo DMG</color> to the opponent's active character. Then, deal 1 <color=#80ffd7>Anemo DMG</color> once again.

<color=#ffd680>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffff>Combat Action</color> : Deal 2 <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> to the opponent's active character. Then, deal 1 <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> once again.

<color=#ffd680>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffff>Combat Action</color> : Deal 2 <color=#80bfff>Hydro DMG</color> to the opponent's active character. Then, deal 1 <color=#80bfff>Hydro DMG</color> once again.

<color=#ffd680>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffff>Combat Action</color> : Deal 2 <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> to the opponent's active character. Then, deal 1 <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> once again.

<color=#ffd680>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffff>Combat Action</color> : Deal 2 <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> to the opponent's active character. Then, deal 1 <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> once again.

Reacts with Elements if they are already applied:
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Cryo Swirl</color> : Deals 1 Cryo DMG to all opposing chracters except the target
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Hydro Swirl:</color> Deals 1 Hydro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Pyro Swirl</color> : Deals 1 Pyro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
[ <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Electro Swirl</color> : Deals 1 Electro DMG to all opposing characters except the target

Applies Pyro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Melt</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Vaporize</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Overloaded</color> : DMG +2 for this instance, the target is forcibly switched to the next character
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> + <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Burning</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Burning Flame</color> ] that will deal 1 Pyro DMG at the end of the Round (Takes effect once, max 2 stacks)

Applies Hydro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Vaporize</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Electro-Charged</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffff>] Frozen</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, the target is unable to perform any Actions this Round (Can be removed in advance after the target receives +2 Physical or Pyro DMG)
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Bloom</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Dendro Core</color> ] that grants +2 DMG to the next instance of Pyro or Electro DMG
[ <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged:</color> Creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> ] that deals 2 <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit. When created or when its usages increase, apply [ <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> ] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.)

<color=#ffffffa6>Applies Electro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Overloaded</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: DMG +2 for this instance, the target is forcibly switched to the next character</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#80ffd6>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Superconduct</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#80bfff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Electro-Charged</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Quicken</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [</color> <color=#ffffff>Catalyzing Field</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] that grants +1 DMG to the next 2 instances of Dendro or Electro DMG</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#80bfff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged</color> <color=#ffffffa6>: Creates a [</color> <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] that deals 2</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit. When created or when its usages increase, apply [</color> <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.)</color>

Applies Cryo and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Melt</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Superconduct</color> : DMG+1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Frozen</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, the target is unable to perform any Actions this Round (Can be removed in advance after the target receives Physical or Pyro DMG, in which case they will take +2 DMG)

<color=#ebe4d8>Physical DMG</color>
Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.
<color=#ebe4d8>Fast Action</color>
You can continue with other actions after conducting 1 Fast Action.
Only after conducting 1 Combat Action will the turn pass over to your opponent.
<color=#ebe4d8>Combat Action</color>
After you finish 1 Combat Action, it will be your opponent's turn.
<color=#ffffff>Playing a card from your Hand with this rule is also a Combat Action rather than a Fast Action</color> .
<color=#ebe4d8>Cost Reduction</color>
Every stack makes playing this card cost 1 fewer Elemental Die. (Can stack, no stack limit)
<color=#ebe4d8>Usage(s)</color>
After this card's effect is triggered, 1 <color=#ffffff>Usage</color> of it will be consumed.
This card will be discarded immediately once it has 0 <color=#ffffff>Usages</color> remaining.
